description: This file contains implementation of ASN.1 message structures and methods for BCCH-DL-SCH messages in 5G NR RRC, including serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: bcch_dl_sch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 CHOICE type for BCCH-DL-SCH message type, with methods for setting, serialization, and packing.

classes.name: bcch_dl_sch_msg_type_c::c1_c_
classes.description: Nested class representing specific choice options for system information and SIB1 messages within the main message type.

classes.name: bcch_dl_sch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 SEQUENCE for BCCH-DL-SCH message, with methods for packing, unpacking, and JSON conversion.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Sets the message type to 'c1' and returns reference to nested object.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to 'message class extension'.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the object to JSON format.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the object into bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the object from bit buffer.

methods.name: set_sys_info
methods.description: Sets the choice to system information and returns reference.

methods.name: set_sib_type1
methods.description: Sets the choice to SIB1 and returns reference.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the nested choice object to JSON.
